context: Yumiko helps Hina-young memorize kanji for a test.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、漢字、覚えられない!
lines.en: Grandma, I can't remember the kanji!
lines.style: Bright, plaintive energy from the start. Quick tempo, voice rising slightly with urgency. Genuine frustration but not angry — seeking help more than complaining. Open, unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Try writing it over and over.
lines.style: Calm, steady voice. Soft focus without condescension. The tone of someone who's said this kind of thing before and means it. Settling Hina down without needing to say much.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pitch lifts slightly on the worry. Tempo accelerates a bit — the timeline is crowding in. Still trying to sound braver than she feels. A small, honest exhale underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Take your time — bit by bit.
lines.style: Warm, grounded delivery. Slight emphasis on 「焦らず」 — not rushing is the point. Slow, deliberate pace. The reassurance of someone who believes this actually works. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Shift to resolution — brighter now, steadier. The decision lands. Quick, light energy. Genuine commitment, no false cheerfulness. Relief at having a path forward.
